description_en: Queries the details of Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools in an MCP Server API product and returns a list of tools. Each tool includes three text fields (name, title, and description) and four map structures (inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations, and meta)
description_zh: 查询 MCP Server 类型的 API 产品所包含的 MCP 工具详情，返回工具列表，每个工具返回名称、标题、描述三个文本成员与 inputSchema、outputSchema、annotations、meta 四个 map 结构成员
name: ListMcpProductTools

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MCP Server API product for which you want to query tool details
parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，指定要查询其工具详情的 MCP Server 类型 API 产品
parameters.name: product_id

tools.description_en: The list of MCP tools. Each element in the list represents an MCP tool
tools.description_zh: MCP 工具列表，列表元素名为 tool，每个元素为一个 MCP 工具

annotations.description_en: The annotation information of the tool, which is a map structure. The API definition declares it only as map<any> without specifying its members or purposes
annotations.description_zh: 工具的注解信息，map 结构；接口定义只声明为 map<any>，未声明其成员与用途

inputSchema.description_en: The input parameter structure definition of the tool, which is a map structure. The API definition declares it only as map<any> without specifying its members or constraints
inputSchema.description_zh: 工具的输入参数结构定义，map 结构；接口定义只声明为 map<any>，未声明其成员与约束

meta.description_en: The metadata information of the tool, which is a map structure. The API definition declares it only as map<any> without specifying its members or purposes
meta.description_zh: 工具的元数据信息，map 结构；接口定义只声明为 map<any>，未声明其成员与用途

outputSchema.description_en: The output result structure definition of the tool, which is a map structure. The API definition declares it only as map<any> without specifying its members or constraints
outputSchema.description_zh: 工具的输出结果结构定义，map 结构；接口定义只声明为 map<any>，未声明其成员与约束

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the MCP Server API product for which you want to query tool details
v1_parameters.help_zh: API 产品 ID，指定要查询其工具详情的 MCP Server 类型 API 产品
v1_parameters.name: productId
